title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1235: Back in time (1)

section.p: Great Han King had betrayed humanity.
Everyone was in disbelief. Even Great Zhou King was greatly pained by this betrayal.
He didn’t want this to be true.
“Tianyuan, stop him!”
Great Zhou King, who had always been a calm person, was roaring furiously.
“I told you it was him long ago. You refused to believe me.”
At that moment, space warped as the River of Time connected to the Human Realm shook before it was severed by someone with a character.
“Back in Time.”

With a command, several characters appeared. Great Han King’s expression changed drastically just as he was about to reach the Human Realm. Instead of moving forward, he started moving backward, as though time was moving in reverse.

Great Han King frowned. Behind him, an expert wearing a golden mask had appeared. The masked individual cupped his hands to the sky and said, “Fellow daoists from the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion, please accept my apology. Zhu Tianfang and I have been borrowing some of your space temporarily. You may have your space back.”
Meanwhile, several Invincibles were fleeing madly with their headquarters in tow in the boundless void.
Fuck!
The Profound Department head was Zhou Tianyuan while the Yellow Department head was Zhu Tianfang. What in the name of all that was holy was this?
Screw those two!
The head of their Profound Department was actually Zhou Tianyuan, the Junior Zhou King who was supposed to be dead.

With a smile, Zhou Tianyuan looked at the River of Time that was flowing backward and said, “I suspected you even back then, but my elder brother refused to believe this. But now, I have been proven right. Liu Jin, are you still trying to return? It’s not happening without my permission.”
Great Han King looked at Zhou Tianyuan and sighed, “Your mastery of time has actually surpassed Wang Hu’s. This is truly a surprise.”
Junior Zhou King sneered and said, “I have been on alert against you. Nobody else suspected you. But I have never doubted my judgment.”
“I can’t remember doing anything that could potentially expose myself.” Great Han King said, “In fact, I have not gotten my hands dirty at all.”

“Heh.” Junior Zhou King asked, “Are you sure? Many years ago, some of our military officials betrayed us. Wasn’t that your handiwork? I was already suspicious back then. Sure enough, you were your betrayal was long in the making.”
Great Han King said nothing. With a rumble, he stomped on the River of Time and forced himself forward yet again. At the same time, numerous beams of light ran through the Human Realm.
Human Realm.
With a roar, the River of Time appeared beside the Yellow Department head. He was going to assemble his main body as well.
At the same time, a loud voice reverberated throughout the Allheaven Battlefield, “Mohe, Tian Dang, summon your real bodies to the Human Realm. The voice could be heard across the various realms.

Six Invincibles had entered the Human Realm. Lade was there with his sole remaining body. Nether River King had died in battle. The dragon king had lost two tri-life bodies. As for the other Invincibles, they were only there in their tri-life bodies. A command had arrived from the various Emperors for them to summon their main bodies over.

That was not all. The Invincibles in the boundless void attacked Great Ming King and the others as they attempted to enter the Human Realm as well. They were determined to kill all the human experts who had shown themselves in the Human Realm.

That was especially true for the multiple character faction. It did not matter if none of them was an Invincible yet. The Culture Tomb must also be taken out of the Human Realm. Great Han King’s betrayal had surprised all the myriad race Invincibles.
An Invincible roared, “Kill Zhou Tianyuan! Help Great Han King!”
At that, several Invincibles charged toward Great Zhou King and Junior Zhou King, keeping them from interfering with Great Han King.

Great Han King’s son, known as Prefect Liu Wushen, had a complicated expression as he roared with desperation, “Father, are you really betraying humanity? Are you going to give up on even your descendants?”
He gathered all three of his bodies from the River of Time.
With a mournful voice, he said, “Your son will be attempting his dao affirmation today. Father, are you going to kill those people in the Human Realm or are you going to protect your son?”
That gave Great Han King some pause. He looked back with a complicated expression.

With boundless sorrow, Liu Wushen said, “My father is a hero! A great hero of humanity! He is not a traitor! Father, don’t abandon the Liu Family! Don’t abandon Great Han! Is the uncertain future you believe in worth betrayal? Father, I’ll start my dao affirmation. If you go, you will lose your son!”
At that moment, the surrounding myriad race Invincibles who were about to attack stopped after receiving new orders. Then, they looked at each other, smiled, and left.
Liu Wushen’s expression changed as he roared with fury, “Bastards! Come kill me!”

After forcefully bringing his three bodies together, he chased the three Invincibles while roaring with desperation, “Come and kill me! Father, they’re trying to kill me! Does this not matter to you at all?”
Someone else laughed and said, “Worry not, Great Han King. We won’t harm Liu Wushen.”
Great Han King frowned and coldly said, “Shut your mouth. I’m doing this for humanity. I’m not an ally of the likes of you.”

“Hahaha. Yes, yes, you’re right. Great Han King, the multiple character faction must fall for humanity’s peace and prosperity. With them around, a war between humanity and the myriad races will be unavoidable. Believe in the future you saw. It won’t be wrong.”
With a sigh, Great Han King stepped on the River of Time again.

Liu Wushen continued roaring with desperation, “NO! NO! Father, they’re doing this deliberately! This is a scheme! They will kill me after your departure! Father! In my mind, you’re a hero, not a traitor! You are not!”
Finally, his three bodies completed their fusion. Rays of multicolored light erupted from his body as source qi converged around him from all directions.
His dao affirmation was starting.
He would be the first to affirm his dao today.

A bizarre scene unfolded. Not a single human attempted to protect him. Not a single myriad race expert attempted to stop him either. In fact, he was the one giving chase to three myriad race Invincibles with the three trying their best to avoid him.
They had to keep their distance from him lest Great Han King misunderstood their intentions.
They were trying their best to assure Great Han King that nobody was going to kill his son, even if his son was attempting a dao affirmation. Go, Great Han King. Go and kill Wan Tiansheng.
Invincibles were everywhere.

Some charged toward the Yellow Department head’s River of Time as they attempted to stop him from assembling his main body. Some charged toward the two Zhou Kings to prevent them from stopping Great Han King.
The human Invincibles previously in charge of protecting Qin Zhen’s group had abandoned them to pursue Great Han King. Even more myriad race Invincibles were attempting to stop them.

Zhou Polong, Zhou Potian, and Qin Zhen were in the middle of fleeing for their lives when Zhou Polong looked around and noted that not a single Invincible was bothered about them anymore. All of them were busy dealing with the two Zhou Kings instead. He made a decision on the spot and announced, “Affirm your dao!”
Qin Zhen asked with stupefaction, “Now?”
“Stop wasting time!”

What a stupid question. Just look at how Liu Wushen who was already on the verge of completing his dao affirmation. All the Invincibles were too busy to deal with them. This was probably the first time ever a human had ever completed his dao affirmation so smoothly. As far as the myriad race Invincibles were concerned, the people inside the Human Realm were far more important than these aspiring Invincibles.
Everything was in a mess.
The three separated and started gathering their tri-life bodies.
When someone finally noticed them and attempted to interfere, Junior Zhou King roared, “Back in Time!”
Once again, Great Han King found himself moving in reverse. He roared with fury, “Zhou Tianyuan, you’re courting death!”
“Great Han King, we’ll stop him for you!”

That pulled the attention of the Invincibles who were just about to interfere with the Zhou Polong’s group away from them. There were four of them. Two withdrew to help Great Han King, leaving two to deal with the three Pseudo Invincibles in the middle of dao affirmation.

Not far away, Liu Wushen was still howling in fury and desperation, “Father! Must you insist on your foolishness! Must you force me to detonate myself here? If you dare to betray humanity, I will kill you! I will kill you to cleanse the dishonor you’re laying upon our family!”
The entire Myriad Realms was in chaos.
The initial plan, or plans, had been thrown into a complete mess.

Even the Invincibles near Xia Longwu looked in the direction where all the commotion was unfolding. With an ashen expression, Great Qin King had to try very hard not to leave as well. He was left gnashing his teeth and muttering in fury, “It’s him! It’s actually him!
“Bastard!”
“Damn it!”
“Liu Jin! Why? Just why?”
Great Xia King was just as furious. He said, “It’s actually him? Longwu, let’s not affirm your dao anymore. I’ll go kill him with Old Qin!”
“Sure.”
With a nod from Xia Longwu, the two Invincibles prepared to leave.
“Heavenly Forge, Wang Hu, Heavenly Sea, the three of you will escort Xia Longwu away. His dao affirmation can wait. I won’t rest before killing Liu Jin!”

The two furious Invincibles started attacking the encirclement madly. Their killing intent surged. Even their opponents were feeling intimidated by the sheer anger and madness they were demonstrating. It felt as though humanity as a whole had gone mad.

Great Han King, one of the ten strongest experts of humanity and one of the five most influential individuals in the Knowledge Seeking Realm, was actually a traitor. In fact, one could even say that he was the third most influential individual after Great Zhou King and Great Ming King.

Only a select few individuals such as Great Shang King enjoyed the same level of influence. Of the human Invincibles, Great Han King was one of the most senior. He might be able to even contend against Great Xia King. That was why his betrayal was such a big surprise to everyone.
“Stop them!”
One of the myriad race Invincibles shouted, determined to block any interference by the two top Invincibles of humanity.
